execution.build: Original source/Makefile jbig2 target, default compiler settings
execution.scope: The original seven approved encoded cases reproduce all nine expected pages. An unchanged first-party Huffman fixture accepted with exact pixels by Rust and jbig2dec crashes this reference; changing declared export counts 0 through 3 in the original TT3 case leaves its reference pixels unchanged. This program is not independent normative acceptance or a general decoder oracle.

implementation_analysis.authorization: Owner explicitly requested detailed reference-implementation analysis to root cause the candidate's regressions.
implementation_analysis.method: Read relevant original decoder, encoder and entropy helpers; debug a separately built source-identical executable using GDB. The earlier black-box execution record above predates this inspection.
